title: Gnosis Wallet Search
tagline: Its a text-based wallet analytics search for gnosischain. Imagine ChatGPT and Gnosisscan have a baby.
description: its like Gnosisscan but instead of inputting an address, the user asks a question. the website then gives the user the answer. it's an easy way for user's to get more info about their wallet or a dex. for now the capability is very limited, but i am planning to build this into a greater suite a data analytics for gnosischain, including for example analytics for cowswap on gnosischain.
how_its_made: its a flask app, so python backend and html-frontend. we use the gnosisscan-api to get wallet-data and then do some analytics and calculations to be able to answer different questions and then feed it to openai's chatgpt-api. it is a data-analytics website, for gnosischain-users.
